page_title: VulnTriage Desk — security report triage in 24 hours
meta_description: Done-for-you security report triage (bug bounty/VDP) with a 24h acknowledgement SLA and a crisp fix plan — without dragging engineers into inbox chaos.
for_whom: For lean B2B SaaS/AI teams (5–150 people) with a public app/API and no dedicated AppSec
hero_headline: Every security report gets triaged in 24 hours (without derailing your engineers)
hero_subheadline: We run your security inbox: validate reports, reproduce safely, rate severity, open tickets with recommended fixes, and keep reporters informed.
credibility_line: NDA-friendly. Least-privilege. No production credentials. You approve any customer-facing statements.
pain_paragraph: Security reports show up at the worst time: a vague email, a bug bounty claim, or a form submission that might be real. Without a process, you either drop everything or ignore it. Both are expensive.
before: A security email lands and nobody knows who owns it
Engineers context-switch to reproduce something unclear
You reply late (or not at all) and trust takes a hit
No consistent severity rubric or disclosure timeline
after: Validated repro steps + severity rating + fix recommendation
Tickets created in your tracker with clear next actions
Professional reporter comms + disclosure timeline tracking
offer_summary: A lightweight, done-for-you security report triage desk. We don't run a pentest — we run the workflow so real issues get handled fast and noise stops stealing engineer time.
included: Security inbox setup (security@ + simple intake form guidance)
Triage: reproduce safely, verify impact, assign severity (CVSS-style)
Deliverable: a ticket with steps to reproduce, impact, and recommended fix options
Reporter communications: updates, clarification questions, closure notes
Weekly status snapshot: open reports, SLA hits/misses, next actions
Retention policy + audit log of actions taken
excluded: Full penetration testing or ongoing vulnerability scanning
Writing new security policies from scratch
Making claims not supported by evidence
Production access (we work from least-privilege logs/sandbox inputs you provide)
process: Fit call: confirm your stack, intake channels, and preferred ticketing tool
Onboarding (60–90 min total): set intake rules, templates, severity rubric, and escalation paths
For each report: intake → validate/repro → severity + recommended fix → open ticket → reporter updates
Weekly: review patterns, tighten scope rules, and reduce repeat noise
pricing_details: Starter includes up to 6 reports/month. Growth ($2,000/mo) includes up to 20 reports/month. Additional reports: $150 each.
guarantee_line: SLA guarantee: if we miss the 24-hour acknowledgement (business days), that report's month is credited $50.

faq.q: How do you access our systems safely?
faq.a: We operate with least privilege: a shared inbox (or forwarding), a sandbox environment if you have one, and read-only access to whatever artifacts you choose to provide (logs/screenshots). No production credentials. Optional NDA and an access log.

faq.q: What do you need from us to reproduce issues?
faq.a: Typically: a staging URL (preferred), a test account, and any relevant logs or feature flags. If staging isn't available, we can still triage impact and craft a fix plan from artifacts — we just won’t claim a verified repro.

We set up (or clean up) the intake channel, define a severity rubric and escalation rules, and create templates for acknowledgement, clarification questions, and closure. Total time from your team is usually 60–90 minutes.
Default is minimal retention: we keep only what’s needed for active triage and the audit log. You can choose a retention window (e.g., 30/90 days) and we’ll delete on request.

faq.q: Will this reduce churn or increase retention?
faq.a: Indirectly: fast, professional responses improve trust with security-conscious customers and reduce the chance a real issue lingers. The primary measurable benefit is fewer engineer interruptions + tighter response SLAs.

trust_basics_line: Not legal advice. We provide best-effort triage and workflow execution; you own final remediation decisions and any public security statements.
